Pilot's manual

WS / ↑↓
Pitch: nose up and down (Invert pitch swaps them)
AD / ←→
Roll: bank the wings to turn
QE
Rudder: yaw the nose, steer while taxiing
RF · ShiftZ
Throttle up and down
Space
Wheel brakes
V
Flaps: more lift at low speed for takeoff and landing
G
Raise or lower the landing gear
1 Chase · 2 Wing
3 Tower · 4 Orbit (drag + scroll) · 5 Fly-by · 6 Free camera (W A S D, Q / E, drag to look)
X Spoilers
Panels on top of the wing that kill lift and add drag. Use them to slow down or descend faster; airliners raise them by themselves on touchdown
T Reverse thrust
On the ground after landing, press T and add throttle to slow down hard
[ ] Trim
Holds the nose up or down a little so you don't have to keep pressing
L · N
Landing lights (light up the runway at night) · parking brake
U Autopilot
Open the panel with the Autopilot button. Set SPD, HDG, ALT and V/S, then press AP. NAV flies to your destination, APP lines up with the runway and lands by itself.
K Push back
When you start at the gate, push back, then taxi to the runway with gentle throttle and Q/E to steer
Game controller
Left stick flies, triggers set throttle, A brakes, X flaps, B gear, Y camera
Phone / tablet
Left stick flies, the bar on the right is throttle, buttons for gear, flaps and brake; TRIM ▼ ▲ and ◀ RUD ▶ next to the stick. On phones the autopilot opens as a sheet at the bottom: tap its handle to fold it to one row
Missions
Switch the briefing to Missions for ten set flights, from a short final in clear skies to a 777 in rain and crosswind, fog, a night ILS and an engine failure. Each awards up to three stars and opens the next
Replay
After a landing or a crash, or from the pause screen, press Replay to watch the last 90 seconds: play / pause (Space), seek with the slider or ← →, speed ×0.5 to ×2, and any camera (1–8). Esc returns
⋯ menu
Sound (engine plus STALL, PULL UP and TRAFFIC alerts), Graphics Low / Medium / High (High adds a real shadow under your aircraft), FPS counter, and your Flight log with the last 20 flights. Your best landing on each route shows in the briefing

Flying a route

  1. Take off: full throttle, flaps 1, pull back at rotate speed.
  2. Climb out: raise the gear and flaps once you're climbing.
  3. Navigate: follow the amber arrow and the map to your destination.
  4. Approach: line up with the runway, flaps 2, gear down, slow to the landing speed.
  5. Land: touch down gently, then hold Space until you stop. Softer landings earn more stars.
  6. Watch for traffic: other airliners and light planes fly between the airports. They show as diamonds on screen and arrows on the map, and you'll hear their radio calls. Fly into one and it's over.
